maya: quick design check — put up a tiny iteration in figma for the playground chat controls: streaming partials, stop/regenerate, token counter, and prompt library preview. need eyes on placement and a11y before we ship the beta preview: https://www.figma.com/file/AbCd1234/playground-chat-controls jon: looked — nice. first thought: stop vs pause labeling. users expect 'Stop' to be destructive. can we use an icon + label that clarifies 'Stop generation' vs 'Pause stream'? maybe prefer 'Pause' for softer UX? :thinking_face: priya: +1 on wording. Also for keyboard users the stop button needs an obvious focus ring. Current mock has focus as a subtle shadow — should be >= 3:1 contrast for the ring per a11y. sam_design: noted. I moved the stop/regenerate to the left side of the toolbar in this mock to avoid accidental hits when interacting with message actions on the right. Thoughts? ava_eng: left alignment feels better for touch. one engineering nit: the streaming partials are rendered as per-token diffs which reflow the DOM a lot. can we batch updates every 150ms? keeps perceived latency but lowers paint churn. maya: good call. batch 150ms sounds like a reasonable default — maybe tune per device. Also want to show a running token counter in the bottom-right of the chat pane. idea: token badge collapsed by default, expands on hover/focus to show prompt/response split and total. jon: token badge expand on hover is nice but add keyboard expand (space/enter) and aria-expanded state. example: ```html
prompt: 24 · response: 100
``` priya: for screen readers, prefer announcing the delta when streaming (e.g., "generating — 3 tokens added") instead of raw counts flooding the SR. Use polite live region. small snippet: ```html
generating — 3 tokens
``` sam_design: about stop/regenerate behavior — if user hits stop then regenerate should reuse the exact prompt; if they edit the prompt first, regenerate should treat it as a new run. we need clear microcopy: disabled tooltip states "edit prompt to regenerate" or "regenerate with same prompt" depending on context. ava_eng: telemetry question — can we include a flag on stop/regenerate clicks to distinguish user-intent vs accidental taps? we'll log event: playground.stop_type = "user_click" | "keyboard" | "timeout". maya: yes let's add an event schema. also: tiny UX ask — add a subtle shimmer placeholder when streaming to help readability when long generations replace earlier content. keep it short, 1–2 lines height. jon: accessibility color nits — the regenerate icon uses a green that fails AA on the token badge. swap to #0e7c6b or add a 2px white stroke on the icon when on colored backgrounds. priya: prompt library preview — we should allow inline preview on hover with truncated preview and an option to 'Insert' vs 'Open'. keyboard users should be able to tab to preview and hit Enter to insert. preview must be readable with 16px default font. sam_design: mapping to the UI: prompt library card has 3 states — collapsed (title), preview (hover/focus shows 2 lines + insert button), and pinned. pinned prompts show a pin icon in the rail and are always visible. how do we want keyboard shortcuts? suggestion: Cmd/Ctrl+K to open library, then arrows to browse, Enter to insert. ava_eng: implementing keyboard nav is straightforward, we'll use roving tabindex and aria-activedescendant for performance. small caveat: on mobile, the library overlay should be full-screen; previews scaled differently. maya: last thing — copy tweaks. change 'Stop' tooltip to 'Stop generation (keyboard: Esc)'. Change 'Regenerate' tooltip to 'Regenerate with current prompt'. Update microcopy in the prompt drawer to 'Favorites' -> 'Pinned' for clarity. jon: +1. also add a tiny confirm for very long-running gen if user clicks regenerate twice in <2s — avoids accidental double-billing. priya: accessibility checklist before beta: 1) keyboard nav for toolbar and library, 2) aria-live polite for streaming updates, 3) focus visible for stop/regenerate, 4) color contrast fixes, 5) screen-reader friendly token announcements. I'll prepare a quick a11y QA run. maya: perfect — @ava_eng and @sam_design will pair on the implementation and I'll stage the preview in beta playground. console-bot: can you post a deploy preview when the branch is ready? console-bot: deploy preview scheduled — will post preview url once CI finishes :gear: ava_eng: ping when preview is up, I'll test 150ms batch + roving tabindex. sam_design: I'll iterate on the microcopy and produce an a11y note in figma. thanks everyone :raised_hands: maya: thanks team! :rocket:
